title: A tank stopped under an arm, inside the skin, stalls the kit's cradle for ever
context: Found in the boss lab's final review (2026-10-08-nih-dairia-boss-lab-final-review-fixes). The port rule is kit unchanged, so it was not fixed there.
outcome: The cradle's minimum gap stays at -0.002 against the -0.0005 limit, so the capture never completes. A player can cause it by driving under the creature and stopping. reset recovers. The lab could refuse a capture that starts inside the skin. For the boss spec; the --boss step parks the tank outside the reach.
